gaps.explanation: The only transfers-in line in detail is the budget schedule's all-funds 'Transfers' 109,502 (detail index 11; Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Total Primary Government, trimmed p20 = printed p48, unaudited), which covers governmental and business-type funds together and is tagged governmental. The fund statements print the transfers per fund column: governmental funds statement trimmed p10 (printed p23) Transfers In General Fund 6,000, Street and Alley Fund 57,252 (City Hall, Park 0; Pool, Grants 0 on trimmed p11); proprietary statement trimmed p17 (printed p30) Transfers Electric (24,700), Sewer 33,550, Water 3,800, Trash 3,800 (added under the business-type transfers_net entry). Per the per-fund rule the combined line is replaced by the fund-column lines: remove index 11 (109,502), add General 6,000 + Street and Alley 57,252 = 63,252. Governmental transfers in: 109,502 + 63,252 - 109,502 = 63,252 vs statement Total 4,800: the remaining 58,452 is exactly the printed Adjustments column (58,452) on trimmed p11 that nets the governmental interfund transfers (the same 58,452 already accepted on the transfers_out side), i.e. gross per fund vs netted Total only (different basis by rule). Note: the budget's 109,502 is 5,100 more than the printed fund-column transfers in (63,252 + 41,150 = 104,402); the budget is cash basis and unaudited, so the statement figures are used.
